<subject>Re: Pit Crew Shenanigans</subject>
<body>
I'm a pro at being a die-hard fan and top-notch armchair planner. I keep waiting for the Kalgoorlie team to ring me up for some strategic advice....





"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/3/2024 4:28:25 PM
To: <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:  

Subject: Re: Pit Crew Shenanigans

Apologies for the late ping – been swamped this week trying to finalise the Albany and Esperance logistics deals, and just realised today I needed to jump on this. Hope to catch you there and find another time for a catch-up. From what I hear, you’re the resident footy expert (right behind Robert Stanley).

Cheers.

cgt

<quoted>
>>> <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au> 29/3/24 4:12 PM >>>

I’d love to take you up on it, but I’m already booked in. I’ll take a raincheck!

Thanks for thinking of me.

Adam




"Devin King" <devin.king@tasmanridge.com.au> on 29/3/2024 4:07:45 PM

To:   <margaret.cox@tasmanridge.com.au>, <adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au>, <eric.moore@tasmanridge.com.au>
cc:

Subject:  Pit Crew Shenanigans

My memory serves that each of you is a bit of a footy fan, like me. I happen to have 4 great seats for Opening Day at Tasman Ridge Stadium, and I definitely need company to make it more fun. I’d love it if you all could join. The game kicks off at 4:05 pm, so we may need to duck out a bit early. But of course, we’ll be discussing critical business all the while, so it’ll be totally justifiable. I’ll bring my notebook for notes.

Let me know. Hope you can make it.

cgt
